Arms Seized Near India Border, Allegations of Pakistan Link

Authorities seized a large cache of weapons that allegedly arrived from across the border. News reports link this to a "new tactic" by Pakistan. One report specifies the weapons were obtained from Pakistan's allies and deployed near India's border by Bangladesh, which is reportedly building cantonments. The coverage raises questions about India's preparedness.
